{{c|''The cau{{ls}}e vvhy he foretelleth them their per{{ls}}ecution by the Iewes, is, that they be not aftervvard {{ls}}candalized thereat. 6 Though they thinke this heauie newes, it is for their vantage that he departeth, becau{{ls}}e of the great benefites that they {{ls}}hal receiue by the comming then of the Holy Gho{{ls}}t, vvho {{ls}}hal al{{ls}}o be his vvitnes again{{ls}}t his enemies. 16 Although in this vvorld they {{ls}}hal {{ls}}o be per{{ls}}ecuted, yet to his heauenly Father they and their praiers made in his name, {{ls}}hal be mo{{ls}}t acceptable. and at length the childe (that is, Chri{{ls}}t in al his members) being borne, their ioy {{ls}}hal be {{ls}}uch as no per{{ls}}ecutor can take from them. 31 Hovvbeit at this in{{ls}}tant of his apprehen{{ls}}ion, they vvil al for{{ls}}ake him.''}}

{{dropinitial|T|fl={{verse|chapter=16|verse=1}}}}{{sc|Hese}} things haue I {{ls}}poken to you, that you be not {{ls}}candalized. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=2}} Out of the {{ls}}ynagogs they vvil {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Heretikes tran{{ls}}late, ''Excommunicate you''. See what corruption this is, and the rea{{ls}}on thereof, ''Annot. c. 9, 22''.}}∷ ca{{ls}}t you: but the houre commeth, that euery one vvhich killeth you, {{ls}}hal thinke that he doeth {{ls}}eruice to God. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=3}} and the{{ls}}e things they vvil doe to you: becau{{ls}}e they haue not knovven the Father, nor me. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=4}} But the{{ls}}e things I haue {{ls}}poken to you: that vvhen the houre {{ls}}hal come, you may remember them, that I told you.⊣ {{verse|chapter=16|verse=5}} But I told you not the{{ls}}e things from the beginning, becau{{ls}}e I vvas vvith you. And novv I goe to him that {{ls}}ent me, and none of you a{{ls}}keth me: VVhither goe{{ls}}t thou? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=6}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Go{{ls}}pel vpō the 4 Sunday after Ea{{ls}}ter.}}But becau{{ls}}e I haue {{ls}}poken the{{ls}}e things to you, {{ls}}orovv hath filled your hart. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=7}} But I tel you the truth. it is expedient for you that I goe. For if I goe not, the Paraclete {{ls}}hal not come to you: but if I goe, I vvil {{ls}}end him to you. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=8}} And vvhen he is come, he {{ls}}hal argue the vvorld of {{ls}}inne, and of iu{{ls}}tice, and of iudgement. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=9}} of {{ls}}inne: becau{{ls}}e they beleeue not in me. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=10}} but of iu{{ls}}tice: becau{{ls}}e I goe to the Father: and novv you {{ls}}hal not {{ls}}ee me. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=11}} and of iudgement: becau{{ls}}e the prince of this vvorld is now iudged. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=12}} {{sup|‖}} Yet many things I haue to {{ls}}ay to you: but you can not beare them novv. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=13}} But vvhen he, {{sup|‖}} the Spirit of truth, commeth, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ If he {{ls}}hal teach al truth, & that for euer (as before c. 14, 16:) how is it po{{ls}}{{ls}}ible, that the Church can erre, or hath erred at any time or in any point?}}∷ he {{ls}}hal teach you al truth. for he {{ls}}hal not {{ls}}peake of him {{ls}}elf: but vvhat things {{ls}}oeuer he {{ls}}hal heare, he {{ls}}hal {{ls}}peake: and the things that are to come he {{ls}}hal {{ls}}hevv you. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=14}} He {{ls}}hal glorifie me: becau{{ls}}e he {{ls}}hal receiue of mine, and {{ls}}hal {{ls}}hevv to you.⊣ {{verse|chapter=16|verse=15}} Al things vvhat{{ls}}oeuer the Father hath, be mine. Therfore I {{ls}}aid, that he {{ls}}hal receiue of mine, and {{ls}}hal {{ls}}hew to you. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=16}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Go{{ls}}pel vpō the 3 Sunday after Ea{{ls}}ter.}}A litle vvhile, and novv you {{ls}}hal not {{ls}}ee me: and againe a litle vvhile, and you {{ls}}hal {{ls}}ee me: becau{{ls}}e I goe to the Father.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=17}} Some therfore of his di{{ls}}ciples {{ls}}aid one to an other, VVhat is this that he {{ls}}aith to vs: A litle vvhile, and you {{ls}}hal not {{ls}}ee me: and againe a litle vvhile, and you {{ls}}hal {{ls}}ee me, and, becau{{ls}}e I goe to the Father? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=18}} They {{ls}}aid therfore, VVhat is this that he {{ls}}aith, A litle vvhile? vve know not vvhat he {{ls}}peaketh. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=19}} And {{sc|Iesvs}} knew, that they vvould a{{ls}}ke him: and he {{ls}}aid to them, Of this you doe que{{ls}}tion among your {{ls}}elues, becau{{ls}}e I {{ls}}aid to you, A litle vvhile, and you {{ls}}hal not {{ls}}ee me: and againe a litle vvhile, and you {{ls}}hal {{ls}}ee me. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=20}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Go{{ls}}pel for many Martyrs.}}Amen,<noinclude>{{continues|amen}}</noinclude>
